# Block reference

Every block a theme can style or override, generated from the platform's own source (`magna` 1.7.0, `magna-cms/pages` 0.6.0-alpha).

For each block:

- **Fields** — what an editor fills in. In an overriding view they arrive as `$block['data']['<field>']`. Treat every one as optional and possibly stale: validate `select` values against the listed options before they reach an attribute.
- **Root classes** — the classes on the block's outermost element. An override should keep them.
- **All classes** — everything core's markup carries, i.e. what your CSS can target without overriding anything. `--*` marks a modifier whose suffix is a field value (e.g. `magna-heading--*` → `magna-heading--center`).
- **Resolved** — server-prepared values in `$block['_resolved'][…]`. The only values a block view may print unescaped are sanitized `_resolved` fields.
- **Behaviour hooks** — `data-magna-*` attributes core's script binds to. An override must keep them.

Field types: `text`, `textarea`, `url`/`link`, `select`, `number`, `boolean`, `media` (a media-library id), `icon`, `richtext` (sanitized HTML — print `_resolved`), `json` (a JSON **string**; `json_decode` it), `repeater` (an array of rows).
